## 2026-11-15：S2原生封存证据反馈适配 v1

新native_browser_feedback_v1直接消费schema3，独立核验原生run/origin/context/target/session/frame、诊断副本／序列、CDP响应／处置、截图／HTML／props绑定和固定环境实际生效。不把schema3改成旧schema2，也不改旧反馈器或浏览器；21项样式加rect须齐全，viewport不隐藏溢出。complete/pass/eligible/clean标志不授予许可；未知／冲突／设施问题优先复核，源oracle与视觉差事实保留。

上轮96payload的6组记录三次离线转换，非新浏览器重复运行。frozen_components共3个开发组件、5静态场景10页，前4项仅visual_match_only，Analytics仍review_source_oracle：10条源诊断、0条目标运行诊断、7项矩形差及1326/1625高度差保留，无伪造SSIM。其余崩溃／不完整／故意跨页负例均设施复核；真实目标修复预览0，不算新迁移率或独立测试。

离线预览每次重读外部固定封存证据和独立绑定manifest，当前Vue／San源码指纹与props不符就拒绝；合成正向调用既有PromptBuilder，禁止网络并保留任意动态键validation及旧目标DOM错误，state不变。源／未知旧visual不静默删除或转发。当前只支持单模块预览；多模块评估／分流仍可，但主文件SHA不证明当前依赖图未变，自动重绑定前拒绝预览，不新增调用方业务材料协议。自动dispatch、语义门绕过和生产协议冻结均false。

新90项（83合成、7旧原生记录）＋旧53/50/39/34/12＝278项定向测试分别通过；完整日志封存，非全仓库或旧273项campaign，初期83/88项成功运行不重复计数。本轮无失败尝试，无新浏览器／模型／人工／依赖／UI／commit／push。75个旧相关文件、3个人工配置、6个冻结输入和旧96payload不变；Notebook仅追加保留旧137单元及metadata；生产Prompt／规则／调度／组件和旧24/30及token不改。报告技能用于保留设施／源基准／目标观察边界，不冒充组件修好。

限制：PNG只验块／CRC／尺寸，不独立重算像素／SSIM；CDP trace无完整params/result或诊断与处置统一时序，不能认证任意生产者或独立证明所有时间关联，原始疑点不清除。完整SSM／当前依赖图、全交互、预置存储／登录和跨机器环境等仍未完成，任意公开键及通知／异常风险不解除。下一步明确错误等级、源oracle警告处置、状态／交互和阈值，审核并冻结受限生产协议后再接批处理，不直接付费全量或独立测试，不新增互操作。

报告：`data/experiments/analysis/native_browser_feedback_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`；接口：`docs/ir-design/native-browser-feedback-v1.md`。以下仅只读检查，未启动Notebook UI。

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p/'migration_pipeline').is_dir() and (p/'notebooks').is_dir())
base = root/'data/experiments/analysis/native_browser_feedback_v1_20261115'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def check_seal(folder, pin=None):
    manifest = folder/'SHA256SUMS.txt'
    if pin: assert sha(manifest) == pin
    lines = manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    for line in lines:
        expected, relative = line.split('  ',1)
        file = (folder/relative).resolve()
        assert file.is_relative_to(folder.resolve()) and sha(file) == expected, relative
    return len(lines)
check_seal(base)
baseline = read(base/'baseline.json')
assert len(baseline['protected']) == 75 and len(baseline['manual']) == 3
for path,pin in {**baseline['protected'],**baseline['manual']}.items():
    assert sha(root/path) == pin, path
for item in baseline['selection']:
    for key in ['source','target']:
        assert sha(root/item[key]['path']) == item[key]['sha256']
prior = root/baseline['prior_seal']['path']
assert check_seal(prior.parent,baseline['prior_seal']['sha256']) == 96
ref = baseline['binding_reference']
assert check_seal(root/ref['bundle_directory'],ref['expected_seal_sha256']) == 130
actions = {'controls':['review_evaluator_or_evidence']*4,'context_smoke':['review_evaluator_or_evidence'],'controls_retry':['review_evaluator_or_evidence']*4,'controls_final':['review_evaluator_or_evidence']*4,'controls_verified':['review_evaluator_or_evidence']*4,'frozen_components':['visual_match_only']*4+['review_source_oracle']}
for folder in ['replay','verified_replay','final_replay']:
    summary = read(base/folder/'summary.json')
    assert summary['actions'] == actions and summary['recordings'] == 6
    assert summary['model_calls'] == summary['browser_runs'] == summary['actual_component_repair_previews'] == 0
    assert not summary['production_auto_dispatch'] and not summary['old_scores_changed']
    for name,expected in actions.items():
        packet = read(base/folder/(name+'.json'))
        assert packet['recording_schema'] == 3 and packet['evidence']['seal_sha256'] == baseline['prior_seal']['sha256']
        assert not packet['repair_dispatch_allowed'] and not packet['production_protocol_frozen'] and not packet['semantic_gate_bypass_allowed']
        assert [s['recommended_action'] for s in packet['scenes']] == expected
        assert all(not s['repair_dispatch_allowed'] and not s['migration_pass_certified'] for s in packet['scenes'])
    packet = read(base/folder/'frozen_components.json')
    assert packet['evidence']['binding']['seal_sha256'] == ref['expected_seal_sha256']
    assert all(not s['target_feedback_eligible'] for s in packet['scenes'])
    scene = packet['scenes'][-1]
    source = [i for i in scene['issues'] if i['channel']=='source_oracle']
    assert len(source) == 10 and all(i['details']['provenance']=='native_session_registry' and i['details']['origin_verified'] for i in source)
    assert not any(i['channel']=='target_runtime' for i in scene['issues'])
    assert len(scene['observation']['style_changes']) == 7 and scene['observation']['metrics'] is None
    assert scene['observation']['dimensions'] == {'source':[1280,1326],'target':[1280,1625]}
tests = read(base/'tests.json')
assert tests['tests_run'] == 278 and tests['new_tests'] == 90 and tests['exit_code'] == 0
assert sorted(row['tests_run'] for row in tests['rows']) == [12,34,39,50,53,90]
for row in tests['rows']:
    assert row['exit_code'] == 0 and re.search(r'\nOK\s*$',row['output'])
    assert int(re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests',row['output'])[1]) == row['tests_run']
implementation = read(base/'implementation.json')
assert len(implementation['files']) == 4 and not implementation['production_rules_prompt_scheduler_or_renderer_changed']
for path,item in implementation['files'].items():
    assert sha(root/path) == item['sha256'] and (root/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == item['frozen_source']
audit = read(base/'audit.json')
assert audit['native_schema_preserved'] == 3 and not audit['legacy_schema_downgrade'] and not audit['legacy_feedback_modified']
assert audit['actual_component_repair_previews'] == 0 and not audit['production_auto_dispatch_enabled']
assert audit['existing_prompt_builder_used_for_synthetic_preview'] and not audit['caller_state_mutated']
assert audit['dynamic_arbitrary_public_key_block_retained'] and not audit['notification_or_exception_boundary_resolved']
assert audit['preview_requires_single_module'] and not audit['current_dependency_graph_rebinding_complete']
assert not audit['pixel_ssim_independently_recomputed'] and not audit['formal_severity_states_threshold_protocol_frozen']
assert audit['new_model_calls'] == audit['new_browser_runs'] == 0
assert audit['original_batch'] == {'configured':30,'passed':24,'failed':6,'execution_errors':0,'total_tokens':1821544}
nb = read(root/baseline['notebook']['path'])
stable = lambda v: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert stable(nb['cells'][:137]) == baseline['notebook']['cells_sha256']
assert stable(nb['metadata']) == baseline['notebook']['metadata_sha256']
print({'targeted_tests':278,'native_schema':3,'real_actions':actions['frozen_components'],'actual_target_previews':0,'auto_dispatch':False,'new_browser_runs':0,'model_calls':0,'old_batch':'unchanged 24/30'})
